project.product: portable power banks and charging accessories
project.requested_format: one long-form video integration or pre/mid-roll

export_notes.adaptation: Rewritten evaluation example; identities, dates and commercial values are invented.

messages.body: Hi Avery, I represent VOLTLEAF and would like to explore one YouTube integration or pre/mid-roll with Circuit Notes. We have a compact power bank and other charging accessories; timing is flexible. A product trial before agreeing a paid collaboration is also an option. Are you interested? Best, Mira
Hi Mira, I handle partnerships for Circuit Notes. We are interested. We could work at USD 42 CPM, calculated from verified views 28 days after publication. Let me know if that works. Best, Avery
Thanks, Avery. The client prefers a fixed fee. What would your rate be for a 75–105 second mid-roll integration in one YouTube video? Best, Mira
Our fixed fee for one 75–105 second YouTube mid-roll integration is USD 4,200. Best, Avery
Thanks for the quote. I will discuss this with the client and come back with their feedback. Best, Mira
Hi Avery, the client has approved an offer of EUR 2,800 for one 75–105 second YouTube mid-roll integration, with payment after publication. Would those terms be acceptable to you? Best, Mira
Hi Avery, following up on the EUR 2,800 offer for the 75–105 second mid-roll, payable after publication. Please let me know whether that works for Circuit Notes. Best, Mira

Hi Mira, yes, we accept EUR 2,800 for one 75–105 second YouTube mid-roll integration and payment after publication. Our shipping details are below. [Shipping details omitted from adaptation.] Best, Avery
Thanks, Avery. Do you have a preferred VOLTLEAF charging product for the video? Best, Mira
We are happy for the client to choose a suitable product from the range. Best, Avery
I will ask the client to arrange shipment of a suitable product. Best, Mira
Hi Avery, the client has arranged the shipment. I do not have a tracking number yet and will share it when available. Best, Mira
Thanks for the update. We will let you know once the product arrives. Best, Avery
